From “Imbalance settlement in Germany (reBAP)”: The reBAP is built from the prices of the balancing energy the transmission system operators activated, with further components that keep its incentive function. One of them couples it to intraday prices, so that being out of balance is never cheaper than closing the position on the intraday market.

From “Desk glossary”: - **Residual load.** Demand minus must-run generation minus wind and solar. When it is negative, the zone has a surplus that exports, storage or curtailment must absorb. - **Price setter.** The block of the supply curve that sets the price in a quarter hour: a gas plant, coal, imports, exports and storage, or renewables curtailing.
